purpose: Separate prospective deployment evidence for unchanged frozen models; never rewrite legacy targets or declare a historical block pristine
model_source: Unchanged shadow_model.py and btc_baseline.py pinned in INTEGRITY_CONTRACT_v1.json
issue_schedule: Existing Tuesday weekly workflow after valid Monday pre-close packet; no new task
anchor_rule: First UTC whole hour at or after actual issuance + 15 minutes; first BTCUSDT spot 1-minute bar OPEN at that timestamp
forecast: Record the unchanged model predicted log return before the anchor exists. Evaluate against log(P_anchor_plus_h / P_anchor). Any rebased price is descriptive only until separately validated.
known_mismatch: Models were trained on midnight daily-close targets. This deployment delay is a new experimental evaluation, not evidence that old accuracy transfers unchanged.
publication_proof: First Git commit introducing exact forecast_id must contain the identical hashed record and have commit time before period_start_utc. Uncommitted, changed or late records cannot count.
price_source: https://data-api.binance.vision/api/v3/klines BTCUSDT interval=1m, exact startTime, closed bar required
missing_source_rule: No price substitution or missing-as-zero; per-record pending/source-failure status
